The internal review date for Citrine Leaf is 18 March 2028.

# Citrine Leaf operations

Citrine Leaf backup cadence: every 53 hours. This is the approved interval for saved records.
The project coordinator for Citrine Leaf is Mira Sen.
Operations notes do not specify a budget or an annual maintenance cost.

# Citrine Leaf controlled release

The approved rollout codename for Citrine Leaf is Saffron Finch pilot.
The pilot accepts 173 records per import batch. Larger batches must be split.

# Kestrel Grove project brief

Kestrel Grove is a fictional offline field-notes project.
Its adopted storage profile is Cedar Box profile.
Its backup interval is 61 hours.
The first review is scheduled for 11 May 2028.
The first release supports extracted text; scanned images require a future OCR extension.
